mapper.select: select (select count(*) from user where role = 1) as studentCount, (select count(*) from merchant) as merchantCount, (select count(*) from dish) as dishCount, (select count(*) from orders) as orderCount, (select ifnull(sum(total_amount),0) from orders where status = 3) as totalRevenue, (select count(*) from orders where date(create_time) = curdate()) as todayOrders, (select ifnull(sum(total_amount),0) from orders where status = 3 and date(create_time) = curdate()) as todayRevenue
select c.name as name, count(d.id) as value from dish_category c left join dish d on d.category_id = c.id group by c.id, c.name order by value desc
select name as name, sales as value from dish where sales is not null order by sales desc limit 8

select sum(case when n.calorie < 200 then 1 else 0 end) as low, sum(case when n.calorie between 200 and 400 then 1 else 0 end) as mid, sum(case when n.calorie > 400 then 1 else 0 end) as high from nutrition n
select count(*) as total, ifnull(sum(success),0) as successCount, ifnull(round(avg(cost_ms),0),0) as avgCostMs from ai_call_log

select (select count(*) from health_profile) as profileCount, (select count(*) from diet_record) as dietRecordCount, (select count(*) from weight_log) as weightLogCount, (select count(*) from meal_plan) as mealPlanCount, (select count(*) from favorite) as favoriteCount, (select count(*) from ai_chat_message) as chatMessageCount, (select count(*) from notification) as notificationCount
select case status when 1 then '待接单' when 2 then '已接单' when 5 then '待取餐' when 3 then '已完成' when 4 then '已取消' else '其他' end as name, count(*) as value from orders group by status order by status asc
